title: Couple sought by Griffin Police in connection with dispute at Walmart | Around The Web | wvnews.com
text:
GRIFFIN — The Griffin Police Department has issues two BOLOs (Be On the Lookout) for a couple involved in an incident that occurred at Walmart on Oct. 26, and for John McDowell, wanted for questioning in a sexual assault case.
Couple sought by Griffin Police in connection with dispute at Walmart
- By Griffin Police Department
